attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file NY state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus. Nexus types: Physical presence (office, employees, property) or Economic nexus (post-Wayfair) $1,000,000 gross receipts threshold.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in NY (office, employees, property)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "NY" streq } over if
apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "NY" streq } over if

action_details.action_dsl: Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500
action_details.action_postfix: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required
action_details.action_dsl: Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500
action_details.action_postfix: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no filing required; No NY nexus - any estimated payments would be refunded

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate NY state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. Additions: Interest on U.S. government obligations (NY Tax Law § 208.9), IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction addback, Certain depreciation adjustments. Subtractions: Interest on NY state and local government bonds, Qualified emerging technology company (QETC) deductions. Reference: NY Form CT-3 Instructions (Article 9-A), NY Tax Law § 208 (Computation of tax), TSB-M-18(1)C - Federal Tax Law Changes

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NY state additions and subtractions; Calculate state additions (federal bond interest, IRC 199A addback, depreciation) and subtractions (NY municipal interest, QETC deductions)
action_details.action_postfix: // Calculate NY state additions and subtractions 0.0 /additions xdef 0.0 /subtractions xdef apportionment.state_additions additions xdef apportionment.state_subtractions subtractions xdef

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no state adjustments; No nexus - no state adjustments calculated

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate NY state corporate income tax. Applies NY 6.5% tax rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income. Process: 1. Federal taxable income apportioned to NY, 2. Add state additions, 3. Subtract state subtractions, 4. Apply NY 6.5% tax rate, 5. Subtract credits, 6. MTA surcharge calculated separately. Reference: NY Form CT-3 Instructions (Article 9-A), NY Tax Law § 209 (6.5% rate), NY Tax Law § 210 (Computation), TSB-M-15(1)C - Corporate Tax Reform

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe tax; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NY tax at 6.5% flat rate; NY uses flat 6.5% rate (Tax Law § 209), subtract credits, calculate refund/owed
No nexus - no tax liability; No NY nexus - any estimated payments are refunded
Nexus but no taxable income - no tax liability; No NY taxable income - NY NOL rules may apply (not implemented)

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate NY MTA surcharge for businesses in MTA region. Surcharge is 0.34% (17/50ths of 1%) of business income base. MTA Region includes: New York City (5 boroughs), Counties: Dutchess, Nassau, Orange, Putnam, Rockland, Suffolk, Westchester. Reference: NY Tax Law § 209-B (MTA surcharge), NY Form CT-3-M/ATT (MTA Surcharge), TSB-M-09(1)C - MTA Surcharge Implementation

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have NY nexus; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq or

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive tax base for surcharge calculation

action_details.action_comment: Calculate MTA surcharge at 0.34%; MTA surcharge is 0.34% of business income base, add to total state tax, recalculate refund/owed
